subject.title: feat(gateway): optional afterSeq catch-up cursor on chat.history

question: Should OpenClaw accept the additive `chat.history.afterSeq` cursor contract once the cursor boundary bug and branch checks are fixed?
rationale: This PR adds a new Gateway protocol surface tied to mobile reconnect behavior, and the linked maintainer-labeled workstream already needs human agreement on the permanent cursor/client contract.

options.title: Accept after fixes
options.body: Land the additive cursor after preserving announce-pair context, clearing generated/lint checks, and coordinating the stacked mobile fallback clients.

options.title: Pause for client design
options.body: Hold the Gateway field until iOS and Android sequence tracking, older-gateway fallback, and in-flight run semantics are reviewed together.

options.title: Reject the cursor
options.body: Keep full-history refresh as the supported reconnect path, avoiding new protocol surface but leaving the linked reconnect friction unresolved.

recommendation.title: Accept after fixes
recommendation.body: Land the additive cursor after preserving announce-pair context, clearing generated/lint checks, and coordinating the stacked mobile fallback clients.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns this proposal and has prior gateway/protocol history for the affected surface.
